headlines.headline: Russell 2000 Enters Correction — Falls 10% From May Peak as Rate-Hold Bets Build
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive base — 10% correction into June created 34% discount to large caps (widest since 2002) that made July relief rally possible; cheap entry is why IWM could lead despite no AI narrative.

headlines.headline: Bank of America: Small Caps Trade at 34% Discount to Large Caps — Widest Since 2002
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive valuation — 34% discount is IWM's fundamental fuel; 40% of Russell is health care + financials, cheap without AI, so broadening beyond Mag-7 directly lifts IWM's P/E, not just price.
